lazy_request_isolation.claim_boundary: This proves synchronous one-slot teardown and fresh-boot replacement on GitHub-hosted Linux TCG. It is not AWS Lambda qualification and does not prove snapshot restore or same-process loadvm isolation.

doc_tcg.lifecycle: fresh file worker and VM for each request
doc_tcg.claim_boundary: These are three fresh-VM TCG samples on one DoC batch host, not a production SLO or persistent-RPC benchmark.

doc_kvm.reason: The experiment account cannot read and write /dev/kvm on the approved batch hosts.

aws_lambda_x86_64_tcg.reason: Real AWS writes and paid qualification require separate operator approval.

qualification_boundary: The wrapper, image reproducibility, hosted-TCG functional parity, hosted-TCG lazy fresh-boot request isolation, and DoC TCG file parity are verified. Snapshot/loadvm isolation, production Lambda qualification, and DoC KVM performance evidence remain open.
